completion_promises.criterion_text: Dedup map is first-wins with a 300s TTL, keyed (event_type, build_id, stage_label or '') for stream events and ('build_queued', correlation_id) for the intake event (ASSUM-006).
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented in slack_notifier.py lines 173 (dedup_map initialization), 194-210 (dedup logic in notify()), and 381-399 (_make_dedup_key() with proper keying for stream events and build_queued intake). Test coverage: TestQueuedIntakeDedupKeyedOnCorrelationId with two test methods.

completion_promises.criterion_text: TTL is measured with a monotonic clock (time.monotonic()), never wall clock; expired entries are evicted on insert.
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented using _monotonic alias (line 75) called in evict logic (lines 401-414 in _evict_expired_dedup_entries()) and notify (line 197). Eviction happens on every notify() call before dedup check. Test coverage: TestDedupTtlExpiry with improved monotonic clock mocking using controlled current_time dict.

completion_promises.criterion_text: A duplicated terminal envelope (same event_type/build_id redelivered within 300s) posts to Slack exactly once.
completion_promises.evidence: Dedup logic in notify() (lines 199-207) checks if dedup_key exists in map within TTL and drops duplicates silently with debug log. Test coverage: TestDuplicateTerminalEnvelopePostsOnce verifies same notification posted twice results in exactly one chat_postMessage call.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Two distinct concurrent terminal events (different build_ids) both post, and each message contains only its own build's fields — no cross-contamination.
completion_promises.evidence: Dedup keys include build_id (line 397-399), ensuring different build_ids create distinct keys and both post. Rendering in _render() (lines 416-512) uses notification parameter fields directly with no shared state. Test coverage: TestDistinctConcurrentTerminalsBothPost verifies two messages with different build_ids both post and contain only their own feature_id.

Worker pacing implemented with _WORKER_PACING_DELAY = 1.0 (line 69) and asyncio.sleep() after every message delivery (line 368). Test coverage: all async tests implicitly verify pacing; TestDistinctConcurrentTerminalsBothPost waits 2.5s for two messages confirming ~1s spacing.

completion_promises.criterion_text: A 429 response honours Retry-After, retries within a bounded per-message retry budget, and on budget exhaustion logs WARNING and drops that message (DDR-007 — never raises).
completion_promises.evidence: 429 handling in worker loop (lines 307-344): attempts_left = _MAX_429_RETRIES + 1 (4 total attempts including initial), SlackApiError with status_code 429 triggers retry with Retry-After header honor (line 326), budget exhaustion logs slack_429_budget_exhausted WARNING and breaks (lines 338-343). Never raises. Test coverage: Test429BackoffHonoursRetryAfter and Test429BudgetExhaustionWarnsAndDrops verify retry logic and budget exhaustion behavior. Fixed bug: changed from retries_left to attempts_left to ensure 1 initial + 3 retries = 4 total attempts.

completion_promises.criterion_text: A mocked 429 burst backs off, keeps delivering subsequent messages after the backoff, and never blocks the subscriber callback or the event loop (enqueue returns immediately; backoff sleeps happen only in the worker task).
completion_promises.evidence: Backoff sleep (line 335) happens inside worker task, not in notify(). notify() uses put_nowait (line 217) ensuring immediate return. Worker continues processing queue after backoff, delivering subsequent messages. Test coverage: Test429BackoffHonoursRetryAfter verifies backoff and subsequent delivery; TestNotifyNeverBlocksEventLoop verifies notify() completes immediately (< 0.1s) even with stalled worker.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Bounded-queue overflow drops the oldest queued message and emits exactly one WARNING per drop; enqueue never blocks and never raises.
completion_promises.evidence: Queue overflow handling (lines 218-237): on QueueFull exception, get_nowait() retrieves oldest message, logs slack_notify_dropped_queue_overflow WARNING once, then put_nowait() enqueues new message. Never blocks (uses put_nowait/get_nowait), never raises (try/except catches and logs). Test coverage: TestOverflowDropsOldestWithOneWarning verifies overflow behavior with small queue.
